title: World impact counter
refreshScope: Checks this bundled dataset only, not official publisher websites.

officialFeeds.description: NOAA daily estimated global seasonally adjusted atmospheric CO2 trend, based on four baseline observatories; recent values may be revised.

indicators.name: Fossil & industrial CO2 emitted
indicators.scope: Global fossil and industrial emissions, including cement-carbonation adjustment

source.title: Global Carbon Budget 2025, final paper (sections 3.1.4 and 3.4)

trend.note: Fossil and industrial CO2 increased 1.0%. Combined fossil plus land-use emissions were marginally below 2024; this trend applies only to fossil and industrial CO2.

indicators.limitations: 38.1 billion metric tonnes of CO2 per year. Estimate / projection, not all greenhouse gases and not net atmospheric accumulation. The final paper's 1.0% annual change supersedes earlier 1.1% press coverage. Uniform rate approximation, not live measurement.

indicators.name: Gross forest area deforested

source.title: FAO: Global deforestation slows, but forests remain under pressure

trend.note: Annual gross deforestation declined to 10.9 million hectares from 17.6 million hectares. This is a comparison of historical decadal averages.

indicators.limitations: 10.9 million hectares per year, a historical decadal average, not a live 2026 observation. Gross deforestation is not net forest loss (4.12 million hectares per year) and is not a count of trees. Uniform rate approximation.

indicators.name: Food waste generated
indicators.scope: Global retail, food service and household food waste, including inedible parts; excludes pre-retail losses

source.title: UNEP: World squanders over 1 billion meals a day

trend.note: Trend not established: headline estimates across editions are not directly comparable because methods and coverage differ.

indicators.limitations: 1.05 billion metric tonnes during 2022. Retail, food service and household waste including inedible parts; excludes pre-retail food losses. Uniform rate approximation, not live measurement.
